purpose: Final pooled multi-seed fairness re-gate (60s) — GAP RUN. Generates the 4 tracks with no HEAD-provenance multi-seed data, at the same depth as the 6 reusable tracks (results/lbb-regate-det/head). Pooled with those 6 for the official 10-track gate.

generatedAtHead.note: b7d7c7d = 3f9a055 + one docs-only commit (docs/LESSONS.md, docs/SIM.md). Sim engine and shared config byte-identical to 3f9a055 (3f9a055db9b55710f53c6f63c6b86397e9fea6a1). 3f9a055 is a direct ancestor of HEAD.

representativeRacerPerTrack._source: server/seeds/tracks/<track>.json defaultRacerTypeId — verified to EXACTLY match the 6 reusable tracks' racers (garden-path=snail, seatrack=dolphin, city-circuit=motorbike, mountainstreet=boarder, searound=manta, ice-track=snowmobile).

depthMatchNote: The reusable arm (results/lbb-regate-det/head) ran ONE representative racer per track (--racer=<defaultRacerTypeId>), 50 races x 6 seeds = 300 races/track. These gap runs mirror that exactly so the 10-track pool is apples-to-apples. --racer is a scope selector (which racerType to simulate), NOT a behavior tunable, so it does not violate the pure-defaults config-match guarantee. Because start-row seeding is derived from (trackId|racerType|globalSeed), the representative racer's races are byte-identical whether run alone or within the full 12-racer matrix.
overrideFlags: NONE for any behavior tunable — pure shipped live defaults. Only --track/--racer/--seed/--races/--dur (scope + depth selectors) are set, matching the reusable arm.

liveDefaultKnobsUsed.source: client/src/modules/storage/defaults.js + client/src/modules/racePlanner.js (the same shared objects the sim reads)

pulkSurge.top3Exclusion: active (structural in racePlanner.js — only target rank >=4 eligible to surge)
